mappedContracts.statement: Provide a manual, disposable-publication canary that creates, reconciles, revises, unschedules, and cleans up uniquely identified test content without affecting production publications.
acceptanceCriteria: The canary is opt-in, account-gated, idempotent by reconciliation, and always attempts cleanup.
It cannot run on pull_request events.
It emits a redacted receipt and marks uncertain outcomes.
